This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.

01.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

3. The petitioners have filed this writ petition with the following prayer:
"It is therefore, prayed that this Hon'ble Court would be graciously pleased to issue notice to the opp parties and after hearing all the parties the impugned notice on dated-04.03.2024 vide L.A Case no- 8/35/2022 issued to the petitioners be quashed and be directed to the opposite parties to consider the grievance petition of the petitioners on dated- 20.03.2024 vide Annexure-4 as per law and be directed to the opposite parties be passed right to fair compensation amount to the petitioners under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in respect of the Acquisition of the petitioners land."
4.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In course of hearing, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners states that the petitioners have already made representation before Opposite Party No.2 vide Annexure-4, and the same may be directed to be disposed of within a stipulated time, to which learned Counsel for the State has no objection.

5. As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.2 to consider and dispose of the representation filed by the petitioners vide Annexure-4 and pass appropriate order as early as possible within a period of three months from Harihara Sahoo And Others vs State Of Orissa And Another ..... ... on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119966160/
1 the date of production of certified copy of this order.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (G. SATAPATHY) JUDGE Subhasmita
